description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain interface hierarchy features, validating interface inheritance, multi-inheritance, method exposure, and state management across different grain interface implementations in the Orleans framework.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceHierarchyTests
classes.description: A test suite verifying Orleans grain interface inheritance and method exposure in various hierarchy configurations.

methods.name: GetHierarchyGrain
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve a grain instance implementing interface T with an integer key.

methods.name: DoSomethingGrainEmptyTest
methods.description: Tests a grain implementing a simple interface hierarchy with basic method invocation.

methods.name: DoSomethingGrainEmptyWithMoreTest
methods.description: Tests a grain with extended interface hierarchy exposing multiple methods.

methods.name: DoSomethingWithMoreEmptyGrainTest
methods.description: Validates interface extension with multiple methods in a grain.

methods.name: DoSomethingWithMoreGrainTest
methods.description: Validates alternative method sets when extending base interfaces.

methods.name: DoSomethingCombinedGrainTest
methods.description: Validates complex interface hierarchy with multiple inheritance paths.

methods.name: DoSomethingValidateSingleGrainTest
methods.description: Ensures state consistency across different interface implementations within grains.
